TikTok Shop Product Description

The Ultimate Phone-Powered Lighter — Never Dies, Never Runs Out!

Say goodbye to dead batteries and empty fuel. Just plug this mini aluminium lighter into your phone's Type-C port for an instant, windproof spark anytime, anywhere!

CORE FEATURES:

Plug-and-Play (Battery-Free): No internal battery! Powered instantly by any Type-C phone, power bank, or laptop. Always ready.

100% Windproof & Flameless: High-temperature electronic ignition that works perfectly even in heavy wind.

️ TSA & Airport Friendly: Contains NO battery and NO liquid fuel. 100% safe for travel and hassle-free at security.

️ Premium Aluminium Body: Sleek, scratch-resistant aircraft-grade aluminium. Heavy-duty protection, feather-light weight.

Pocket Size EDC: Smaller than a thumb drive. Perfect for camping, hiking, survival kits, and everyday carry.

️ SPECIFICATIONS:

Material: Premium Aircraft-Grade Aluminium Alloy

Interface: USB Type-C (Plug & Play)

Package Includes: 1 x Mini Type-C Portable Lighter

NOTE FOR BUYERS:

Please use a slim phone case or ensure enough space around your Type-C port for a secure connection.
